fact: INTIC's internal regulation, published in the Boletim da República of 28 March 2022, gives its Audit and Compliance Department the task of auditing public administration information systems against established principles, rules and standards.
title: Regulamento Interno do Instituto Nacional de Tecnologias de Informação e Comunicação (INTIC, IP)
publisher: Imprensa Nacional de Moçambique (Boletim da República)
